description:
Hi! I'm a student passionate about STEM and tech, currently learning programming and excited to solve real-world problems for NASA Space Apps. I'm building a team to turn space data into impactful projects.

Looking for: Designers (UI/UX, Pitch Deck), Researchers (Scientific Writing, Data), and Coders.

Join me!
summary:
TERRA-X is a web tool that uses open space data to find and compare test sites on Earth.
It shows how similar a place is to a Moon or Mars site, and why.
Users: mission teams, astronaut trainers, researchers, students.
details:
How does it work:

1. Choose a target on the Moon or Mars

2. Compare Earth sites using open NASA and space agency data

3. See a similarity score and a clear explanation

Impact:

  • Adds a new analog site: It adds a well-documented analog site to the unfinished list in the brief.
  • Provides open data: It shares free, open data and a simple scoring method that anyone—including students—can easily reuse.
  • Speeds up site selection: It helps space mission teams choose their test sites much faster.

Coding language: HTML, using SI to support
